bugFixer.title: Bug fixer
bugFixer.subtitle: Every ledger, stock, cash, tax and production problem lands here: from Tally loads, from the checks on each entry, and from the factory. Each is put right with the proper ledger or entry before anything posts · Admin and the CA · loaded Tally data is never edited
bugFixer.whoNote: Admin fixes cash, stock and mapping. Anything that changes the balance sheet or profit waits for the CA.
bugFixer.noRight: You can see these problems but not close them. Ask Admin for the Bug fixer right.
bugFixer.emptyBody: Problems arrive from Tally loads and the checks. Run the checks to look again.
bugFixer.pickOne: Choose a problem to see what was found and how to fix it.
bugFixer.noDiff: No field differs; only Tally's change counter moved.
bugFixer.toMapping: Map it on the company's Tally books page →
bugFixer.toClassify: Classify the bills on the company's Tally books page →
bugFixer.notePlaceholder: Why this is the right fix
bugFixer.noteRequired: Say what was decided (at least 5 characters). It goes into the user log.
bugFixer.signNote: The fix is dated, signed with your name and kept in the user log. Fixes that change a statement wait for the CA's approval before they post.

how.title: How fixing works
how.h1: Found on every load and every entry
how.p1: Tally loads, production entries, packing runs, lab results and stock moves all run checks; each problem arrives here with where it was found.
how.h2: Tally data stays as it came
how.p2: A fix is a new, dated entry or a mapping in the ERP. The loaded vouchers are never changed, so the trail back to Tally is complete.
how.p3: Saving a fix as a rule applies it to every similar voucher, and to the next backup you load.
how.p4: Admin fixes cash, stock and mapping. Anything that changes the balance sheet or profit waits for the CA.
how.p5: A fix dated in a closed year needs the “Reopen closed day” right and goes to the CA.
how.p6: Go-live is blocked while any problem in a company is open, so the ERP never starts with wrong balances.
